main_text.head: EXERC. XLVII.
ARTICVLORVM IMBECILLITATIS causæ.
main_text.p: Arthritidis proxima efficies caufa dicitur effe articulorum imbecillitas, quę pluribus modis comparatur: uel feminaria contagione ab arthriticis parentibus, quorum semel[?] hac lue uitiatum erat, unde hereditaria arthritis nuncupatur, quę in posteros migrat: uel immoderato uene-ris usu, quo spermaticæ partes plurimum lacessuntur. Propterea Hippocrates Aphorismo uicesimo octauo, Sectionis sextæ, eu nuchos podagra nō laborare, scriptum nobis reliquit. Item & tricesimo, eiusdem Sectionis Aphorismo puerum ante usum ueneris podagra non laborare affirmauit: uel immodicis concitatisq; ambulationibus, uel impulsationibus, aut luxationibus, aut deniq; aliis offensionibus, quę articulis extrinsecus accidunt. Reliquæ uero euidentes causæ, non solum imbecillitatem articulorum, sed etiam quæ fluit, fluxuraq; est, materiam procreant. Sunt autem huiusmodi edulium frigidorum, uel multorum bonorum, aut malorum eius, uinolentia, crapula,

page.notes: The first word "Arthritidis" begins with a large initial A, joined to the rest of the word. "efficies" is printed with an accent over the final s-like letter, read here as efficies. "semel" is printed with a macron, read as semel[?]. "octauo" is printed with a ligature that could be read differently, kept as octauo. "eius" is printed with a long-s-like form, read as eius. No marginal notes on this page.
